deep_review.conclusion: Inventory is complete. Use requires protected provider credentials, explicit workspace and command boundaries, review of generated shell/file operations and acceptance of the extension's unmaintained status; no provider or command was invoked.

semantic_review_progress.scoped_deep_review: Credential, workspace-mutation and arbitrary-command triggers reviewed narrowly. The custom agent connects to configured model providers and registers file mutation plus shell tools. The shell helper checks a short unsafe-pattern list, which is not a complete command sandbox, and the upstream README says the extension is no longer maintained.

repository_intelligence.reuse_recommendation: Prefer the maintained successor product; use archived code only as historical design reference after license review.
repository_intelligence.inspection_scope: Bounded review of pinned README; capability clusters describe repository-level reuse, not an exhaustive asset inventory.
repository_intelligence.license_notes: No SPDX license assertion in repository metadata; verify before reuse.
risk_notes: README states the repository is no longer actively maintained and product has moved; compatibility and licensing need verification.
